title: the family house on Kessler Street Rising
author: Noor Fairweather
blurb: Kestrel Thornbury, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
